comments.text:
Is this very short section of road really named Saint Margaret Street?
https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/406370789

It's really short and completely separate from the (currently 3) sections of St. Margaret Street (note there it's St. not Saint) a bit further south (to the southeast of Parliament Square).

In other maps, that is either Parliament Square or the whole eastern part from there to the lower Saint Margaret Street, it's all Saint Margaret Street and not Parliament Square.

If the current situation is really correct (even the St. vs. Saint difference), a note=* tag should be added to this street segment and the eastern Parliament Square section, as it looks wrong and will help future mappers looking at this again.
